''' Arts and culture'''
*[[80th Venice International Film Festival]]
**The film ''[[Poor Things (film)|Poor Things]]'', directed by [[Yorgos Lanthimos]], wins the 2023 [[Golden Lion]] award at the [[Venice International Film Festival]]. [https://www.euronews.com/culture/2023/09/09/venice-film-festival-2023-yorgos-lanthimos-poor-things-wins-80th-editions-golden-lion (Euronews)]

''' Law and crime'''
*[[White Terror (Taiwan)]]
**[[Taiwan]]ese President [[Tsai Ing-wen]] restores the reputations of victims of the [[White Terror (Taiwan)|White Terror]] repression, which was carried out by the [[Republic of China|Kuomintang]] government from the 1940s to the 1980s. The ceremony, held in [[Taipei]], marked the first nationwide event that addresses crimes committed during the White Terror. [https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2023/09/10/2003806022 (Taipei Times)]

''' Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Artsakhian presidential election]]
**The [[National Assembly (Artsakh)|National Assembly]] of the [[breakaway state]] [[Republic of Artsakh]] elects [[Samvel Shahramanyan]] as its new [[President of Artsakh|president]]. [https://www.svoboda.org/a/novym-glavoy-nagornogo-karabaha-izbran-samvel-shahramanyan/32585325.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2023 Maldivian presidential election]]
**[[Maldivians]] vote for a [[President of the Maldives|president]]. No candidate receives a 50% majority, so incumbent President [[Ibrahim Mohamed Solih]] will face opposition candidate and [[Malé]] mayor [[Mohamed Muizzu]] in the second round on September 30. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tropical-maldives-heads-polls-closely-watched-by-india-china-2023-09-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 WTA Tour]]
**[[2023 US Open (tennis)|2023 US Open]]
***In [[tennis]], [[Tennis in the United States|American]] [[Coco Gauff]] wins the [[2023 US Open – Women's singles|women's singles title at the 2023 US Open]], her first [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|major]] singles title, after defeating [[Belarus]]ian [[Aryna Sabalenka]] in the final.
